![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-333333?style=flat-square) ![Gradio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gradio-333333?style=flat-square) ![chromadb](https://img.shields.io/badge/chromadb-333333?style=flat-square) ![RAG](https://img.shields.io/badge/RAG-333333?style=flat-square) ![claude](https://img.shields.io/badge/claude-333333?style=flat-square) ![Genspark](https://img.shields.io/badge/Genspark-333333?style=flat-square)

**How you are solving it**

AeroQuiz is an intelligent Telegram-based quiz platform that:

📱 Built for the Hangar Floor - Telegram runs seamlessly on the iPads engineers already carry, enabling training on-the-fly between tasks without leaving the hangar
🤖 Leverages GenSpark Claw to seamlessly connect with Telegram, intelligently handle user queries, and provide real-time conversational interactions
🧠 Powered by Claude Sonnet 4.5 for intelligent question generation, answer evaluation, and detailed explanations for incorrect responses
📚 RAG Pipeline that ingests aircraft PDF manuals and technical documentation to generate contextually relevant questions
⚡ Expedites certification by enabling trainees to learn faster through active recall and instant feedback Link to 

Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aGdeoUOQdcU

**Use of Claude**

AeroQuiz uses Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the core intelligence layer for two critical functions. First, question generation: after the RAG pipeline retrieves the most relevant chunks from aircraft maintenance manuals (AMM, CMM, SRM), Claude is prompted to generate technically precise multiple-choice questions grounded strictly in those excerpts — covering procedures, safety limits, warnings, and system operation. Claude returns structured JSON with the question, four options, the correct answer, difficulty level, and a manual citation. Second, answer evaluation and explanation: when an engineer selects a wrong answer, Claude generates a detailed, contextual explanation citing the exact section of the manual — turning every mistake into a learning moment. This ensures zero hallucination risk since Claude only reasons over content retrieved from the actual manuals, not external knowledge.

**The problem your project solves**

Singapore Airlines' aircraft maintenance engineers face a critical challenge: rapidly upskilling probationary engineers while ensuring they have deep knowledge of complex aircraft systems, safety protocols, and maintenance procedures. Traditional training methods are time-consuming and don't scale effectively.

The Mobile Workforce Challenge: Unlike desk workers, aircraft engineers are stationed in hangars working on planes — they don't have access to laptops or desktop computers. However, every engineer carries an iPad loaded with aircraft manuals and company apps. This creates a unique opportunity for mobile-first training solutions.

**What is the deployed URL for this project?**

telegram bot @ aeroquiz_bot

**Use of Genspark**

AeroQuiz uses GenSpark Claw as the orchestration and agent layer that powers the entire Telegram bot experience. GenSpark Claw connects directly to the Telegram Bot API, handles incoming messages from engineers, manages conversation state across quiz sessions, and routes user intents to the appropriate backend functions — whether that's starting a new quiz, answering a question, checking the leaderboard, or fetching a topic-specific session. It also handles the admin workflow: when an admin uploads a PDF manual to the Telegram channel, GenSpark Claw intercepts the document, triggers the RAG ingestion pipeline, and confirms successful indexing. GenSpark Claw acts as the intelligent middleware that makes the entire experience feel conversational and seamless without engineers needing to interact with any interface other than Telegram.

### SpectraShield
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/spectrashield-5ea3) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Cepheus%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://cepheus-2.devfolio.co)

> AI-Powered Sports Media Protection System

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SpectraShield is designed to prevent unauthorized copying and reuse of sports images.
Existing systems only detect duplicates but cannot track ownership or provide proof.

Our system uses image hashing to detect duplicate or modified images and treats the first uploader as the owner. It also adds a watermark for ownership proof. When similar content is uploaded, it is marked as unauthorized, and the system shows similarity, risk level, and source (simulated).

Key features include duplication detection, watermark-based ownership, real-time alerts, and PDF report generation. Additionally, users who repeatedly upload unauthorized content (3 times) can be suspended.

We use React for frontend, Node.js for backend, and image hashing for detection.

![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Google Maps API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Maps%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![HTML5​](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML5​-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Many small and medium-sized cities still lack real-time public transport tracking systems.Passengers depend on fixed bus schedules without knowing actual arrival times.This causes uncertainty and long waiting times at bus stops.Transport authorities face difficulty in monitoring vehicle movement and route performance.Delay and route-change information is not communicated to passengers in advance.The absence of a centralized tracking system reduces the efficiency of public transport services.Therefore, a GPS-based real-time tracking solution like TrackMe is required to improve passenger convenience and fleet monitoring.This project is used by people

- To provide live bus location updates using GPS technology.
- To calculate and display Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for passengers.
- To reduce passenger waiting time and improve travel planning efficiency.
- To enable transport authorities to monitor vehicle movement and route performance.
- To create a centralized platform for real-time tracking and information sharing.
- To support the development of smart and efficient public transportation services through the TrackMe system.

**Challenges we ran into**

- Real-time update delay: GPS data was not updating instantly.
→ Fixed by optimizing API calls and update frequency.
- Inaccurate ETA: Initial calculation was static.
→ Improved using speed + continuous location updates.
- Map integration issues: Markers not updating properly with Google Maps API.
→ Handled dynamic marker updates using JavaScript.

### Astrophage
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/astrophage-2f91) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/pushkarrathi/astrophage) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I0_p9Ah-QIVoDsXCVb11PBENuGYMreeh/view?usp=sharing) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DAYZERO%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dayzero2o.devfolio.co)

> The Action Oriented AI Agent

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Electron](https://img.shields.io/badge/Electron-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![AI/ML](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI/ML-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Astrophage is an AI-powered system designed to convert natural language instructions into real-world task execution across multiple platforms. Instead of requiring users to manually operate different tools like GitHub, email, or file systems, it allows them to simply describe what they want, and the system handles the rest. It works by taking user input (text or voice), understanding the intent using an AI model, breaking the task into smaller steps, and then executing those steps through APIs and system-level actions. It also stores context and past interactions to improve future performance. This project is useful because current workflows are fragmented and time-consuming, and existing AI tools can only suggest solutions rather than execute them. Astrophage bridges this gap by combining AI understanding with automation and real execution, making it easier for both technical and non-technical users to complete tasks efficiently.

**Challenges we ran into**

While building Astrophage, we faced several key challenges.
First, accurately understanding user intent was difficult, especially when instructions were vague or multi-step, as the AI needed to correctly interpret and break them down into executable actions.

Second, ensuring reliable execution across multiple platforms like GitHub, email, and file systems was complex due to API limitations, authentication issues, and handling failures in real time.

Another major challenge was maintaining safety and control, since allowing an AI system to perform actions can be risky, so we had to think about permission handling and confirmation mechanisms.

Additionally, managing multi-step workflows and ensuring each step executes in the correct sequence without errors required careful planning and system design.

Finally, integrating all components—AI, backend, APIs, and memory—into a smooth, responsive system was a challenge in itself, especially within the limited time of a hackathon.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/skillx-a322) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://exchangeskillx.netlify.app/) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DAYZERO%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dayzero2o.devfolio.co)

> “Empowering Collaboration Through Skill Exchange.”

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

SkillX addresses the lack of effective collaboration and skill utilization among students and developers. Many people have valuable skills but no platform to exchange them without money, making learning less accessible. At the same time, finding the right teammates for projects is difficult, and many ideas are left incomplete due to lack of support. SkillX solves these problems by enabling skill-based exchange, easy team formation, and allowing users to continue unfinished projects, ensuring that skills are used effectively and innovation is not wasted.

**Challenges we ran into**

During the development of SkillX, we encountered several challenges. One of the main challenges was integrating the frontend with the backend, as ensuring smooth communication between the user interface and APIs required careful handling of data formats and requests. Setting up and connecting MongoDB Atlas also posed difficulties, especially with connection errors, network access configuration, and authentication issues.

Another challenge was replacing mock data with real-time data without breaking the existing UI. Since the frontend was initially built using static data, transitioning to dynamic data required restructuring parts of the code. Additionally, handling errors such as login validation mismatches and API response inconsistencies required debugging and refining both frontend and backend logic.

We also faced challenges in managing time effectively during development, deciding which features to prioritize, and ensuring that the core functionalities worked reliably for demonstration. Overcoming these challenges helped us improve our understanding of full-stack development and build a more robust prototype.

### Moodly
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/moodly-eafc) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://moodly-final.vercel.app) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/bwq0eV6wu8U?si=LEu3VYXGYrQusJwO) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DAYZERO%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dayzero2o.devfolio.co)

> Track your mind before it falls behind..

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Moodly addresses the challenge of **undetected cognitive decline and burnout**, particularly among students and high-performing individuals who often continue functioning while their mental efficiency gradually deteriorates. Existing solutions largely depend on manual mood tracking or self-reporting, which are subjective, inconsistent, and often delayed.

Moodly introduces a **behavior-driven** monitoring system that passively analyzes user interaction patterns and performance indicators to detect early signs of cognitive drift. By identifying subtle deviations in focus, consistency, and engagement, the application enables users to take corrective action before burnout fully develops.

The platform improves user experience by:

- Eliminating the need for manual input
- Providing real-time insights into mental performance
- Offering early warnings and actionable feedback
- Enhancing productivity while safeguarding mental well-being

Overall, Moodly transforms mental health tracking into a **proactive and predictive** system, making it more reliable and effective.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the main challenges was developing a reliable **emotional escalation metric**, as mapping behavioral signals to meaningful states (stable, strained, drifting) required careful calibration. Early versions were either too sensitive or not responsive enough, which was improved through iterative tuning and normalization against user baselines.

Implementing **popup notifications** presented challenges in timing and usability, as frequent or intrusive alerts could disrupt the user experience. This was addressed by refining trigger logic and ensuring non-intrusive placement.

Additionally, maintaining a scalable **project structure** became difficult as features expanded. This was resolved by reorganizing the codebase into modular components with clear separation of concerns, improving maintainability and future scalability.

Team **CodeX** -- Liya Sajad, Fathima Safreen, Afsal S

### SEVA SETU
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/seva-setu-ai-powered-civic-issue-reporting-and-resolution-platform-3054) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/sivaadithya25/SEVA_SETU) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/vNcI7NwBUms) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-DAYZERO%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://dayzero2o.devfolio.co)

> Report issues. Improve your city.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Leaflet](https://img.shields.io/badge/Leaflet-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenStreetMap](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenStreetMap-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Router-333333?style=flat-square) ![FAST API](https://img.shields.io/badge/FAST%20API-333333?style=flat-square) ![Uvicorn](https://img.shields.io/badge/Uvicorn-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

**The problem it solves**

In many cities, civic issues like potholes, water leakage, garbage accumulation, and broken infrastructure are common. These problems directly affect daily life, yet they often remain unresolved for long periods.

The core issue is not just the presence of these problems, but the lack of a structured and efficient reporting system.

Currently:

Citizens don’t know where or how to report issues properly
Complaints are scattered across different platforms or ignored
Authorities lack clear visibility and prioritization
No centralized system exists to track recurring or high-priority issues

Because of this, even simple problems:

- Take too long to resolve
- Get reported multiple times without coordination
- Are forgotten due to lack of tracking

This leads to:

- Reduced quality of life
- Safety risks (e.g., accidents due to potholes)
- Frustration among citizens

**💡 How Seva Setu solves this**

Seva Setu provides a centralized, user-friendly platform where:

Citizens can report issues with:

1. Exact location (map-based)
2. Image evidence
3. Clear descriptions
4. Authorities can:
5. View all issues in one place
6. Identify clusters and problem hotspots
7. Filter issues based on status (Pending / Resolved)
8. Take faster and more informed decisions

By making problems visible, organized, and trackable, Seva Setu transforms scattered complaints into actionable data.

**🎯 Impact**

- Faster issue reporting and response
- Better transparency between citizens and authorities
- Data-driven decision making for urban management
- Reduction in unresolved and recurring civic problem

**Challenges we ran into**

**Challenges I ran into**

Building Seva Setu within a limited hackathon timeframe came with several practical and technical challenges.

**1. Integrating Maps with Frontend & Backend**

One of the major challenges was handling location data flow between the frontend and backend.

- We used **Leaflet (React-Leaflet)** for maps and **OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) **for geocoding
- Initially, there were issues with:
- Incorrect or inconsistent coordinates
- Address formatting differences
- Map markers not reflecting backend data properly

**How we solved it:
We standardized the data flow by:**

- Sending precise latitude and longitude from frontend
- Handling reverse geocoding carefully in backend
- Ensuring consistent structure between API and UI

**2. Frontend–Backend Integration Issues**

Connecting React frontend with FastAPI backend was not smooth initially.

- Faced CORS errors
- API responses were not aligning with frontend expectations
- Debugging async requests took time

**How we solved it:**

- Configured proper CORS middleware in FastAPI
- Used consistent API response formats
- Tested endpoints using Swagger before integrating with frontend

**3. Working with New Tech Stack Under Time Pressure**

As a team, we were exploring new technologies like FastAPI, Leaflet, and modern React setup (Vite).

Learning and implementing simultaneously was challenging
Required quick debugging and adaptation

**How we handled it:**

- Divided tasks efficiently within the team
- Focused on building a working prototype first
- Avoided over-engineering and prioritized core features

**4. ML Training in Limited Time**

We planned to integrate AI-based image classification for detecting issue types (potholes, water issues, etc.).

However, training a reliable model requires:
Dataset collection
Labeling
Proper training time

Current status:

ML pipeline is being prepared
Integration is planned for next iteration

**The problem it solves**

The Problem It Solves
Municipal issue reporting is often slow, fragmented, and hard to track. People report potholes, broken lights, flooding, unsafe areas, or waste problems through different channels, with little visibility into what happens next. Teams on the city side also lose time manually triaging reports, prioritizing urgency, and assigning the right responders.

CivicConnect solves this by turning reporting and response into one connected workflow:

Citizens can quickly submit location-based issues with photos and clear descriptions.
The system helps classify and prioritize incidents so urgent cases are escalated faster.
Admin teams get a live control view to dispatch responders with better accuracy.
Responders can see assigned tasks clearly and update status in real time.
Everyone gets better transparency, from report creation to resolution and archive.
What People Can Use It For
Reporting local civic problems in one place (roads, sanitation, lighting, safety, utilities).
Reducing confusion about where to report and who is responsible.
Speeding up emergency and high-priority municipal response.
Improving collaboration between citizens, dispatch teams, and field responders.
Creating a more accountable and data-driven 311-style service model.
Why It Makes Existing Work Easier and Safer
Faster triage reduces delay for critical incidents.
Smarter assignment lowers the chance of sending the wrong team.
Centralized tracking cuts manual coordination overhead.
Real-time status updates improve operational clarity.
Better routing and prioritization can reduce risk for both citizens and response teams.

### TradeX
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/tradex-4c30) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/6FBgjN8jHaU?si=SRplMN6Y0ZHs_4UU) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Innovate--Iterate--Interrupt%20(III)%205.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://innovateiterateinterrupt-iii-5.devfolio.co)

> Trade evolved with time.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

🎯 The Problem

India has 190 million+ demat accounts, yet 90% of retail traders lose money in their first year.

• No safe practice ground — New traders risk real capital while learning. One bad trade can wipe out months of savings.

• Information overload — Dozens of indicators, conflicting signals, and scattered news. Traders don't know what to trust.

• Expensive tools — Institutional-grade analytics (Bloomberg, Reuters) cost ₹50,000+/year — inaccessible to students and beginners.

• Emotional trading — Without data-driven conviction, traders chase tips, panic sell, and revenge trade.

• Fragmented workflow — Switching between chart platforms, news sites, screeners, and brokers wastes time and causes missed opportunities.


✅ How TradeX Solves It

1. Risk-Free Learning Environment
Trade 15 NIFTY 50 stocks with ₹1,00,000 in virtual capital. Make mistakes, test aggressive strategies, and build confidence — without losing a single rupee.

2. One Unified Conviction Score
Instead of drowning in 20+ indicators, TradeX fuses XGBoost ML prediction + FinBERT news sentiment + Connors RSI-2 into a single 0–100 Conviction Score with a clear BUY / HOLD / SELL action. No more analysis paralysis.

3. Institutional-Grade AI — For Free
The same tools hedge funds use — gradient-boosted price forecasting, NLP-powered sentiment analysis, regime detection, and price-sentiment divergence alerts — accessible to anyone with a browser.

4. Data-Driven, Not Emotion-Driven
Every trade decision is backed by quantifiable signals. The Confluence Engine tells you why it's recommending an action — which model agrees, which disagrees, and what the dominant signal is.

5. Everything in One Place
Live prices, technical charts, AI predictions, news sentiment, portfolio tracking, risk scoring, and a global leaderboard — all in a single premium interface. No tab-switching. No paid subscriptions.


💡 In short:
TradeX bridges the gap between "I want to trade" and "I know how to trade" — by giving every aspiring trader an AI-powered sandbox to learn, practice, and build conviction before committing real capital.

**Challenges we ran into**

⚡ Challenges I Faced

1. Real-Time Price Simulation Without Paid APIs
Getting realistic price movement without a paid market data API was tricky. Random noise made prices look fake. I solved this by implementing an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reversion process — a stochastic model from quantitative finance — that anchors simulated prices to real Yahoo Finance data. The result is price movement that feels authentic without needing a ₹50,000/year data feed.

2. FinBERT Model Loading Time & Memory
The FinBERT transformer model is ~420MB and takes 15-20 seconds to load. This caused the first sentiment request to timeout. I fixed this by pre-warming the model in a background thread during server startup, so it's ready before any user hits the endpoint. I also added graceful fallback to mock sentiment if the model fails to load on low-memory machines.

3. Fusing Three Different Signal Types Into One Score
The hardest engineering challenge was combining XGBoost predictions (continuous price values), FinBERT sentiment (categorical: positive/neutral/negative), and Connors RSI-2 (0-100 oscillator) into a single meaningful Conviction Score. Each signal has different scales, confidence levels, and update frequencies. I designed a weighted scoring system where each component contributes up to ~33 points, with regime-aware RSI mapping and confidence-scaled sentiment, so no single model can dominate the final score unfairly.

4. WebSocket Price Broadcasting From a Sync Thread
The price drift loop runs in a synchronous background thread (because it uses time.sleep), but WebSocket broadcasting is async. Bridging sync-to-async in FastAPI without race conditions or event loop conflicts required creating a new event loop per broadcast cycle and carefully handling dead client cleanup to prevent memory leaks.

5. XGBoost Feature Engineering & Overfitting
My first XGBoost model had great training accuracy but terrible test performance — classic overfitting. I iterated through feature engineering (adding Bollinger Band width, momentum, volatility), added regularization (L1/L2), tuned hyperparameters (subsample=0.8, colsample=0.75, min_child_weight=3), and used a proper 80/20 temporal split (not random split, which leaks future data). The final model achieves meaningful directional accuracy without memorizing noise.

6. Handling yfinance Rate Limits During Startup
Downloading 1 year of OHLCV data for 15 stocks sequentially at startup was slow and sometimes hit Yahoo Finance rate limits. I added per-symbol error handling with fallback prices so one failed download doesn't crash the entire platform — the app starts with whatever data it can get.

**The problem it solves**

Drishti eliminates the guesswork in e-commerce marketing by making websites respond to users in real time — based on how they actually behave and responds.

Most e-commerce websites show the same static content to every visitor, regardless of whether they're engaged, confused, or about to leave. **Drishti** changes that by acting as an AI-powered marketing co-pilot that plugs into any website with a single script tag.

How it works :
Reduces bounce rates — When a user scrolls fast and is about to leave, Drishti automatically changes the headline and CTA to something more compelling (e.g., "Still looking? Grab this now!" with a "Buy Now" button), keeping them on the page.

Responds to user emotions - Using optional webcam-based emotion detection, Drishti can identify if a user looks confused, bored, or excited, and adapt the content accordingly - showing simpler navigation for confused users, or premium products for engaged ones.

Reorders products dynamically - Instead of a fixed product grid, Drishti reorders and highlights products based on behavior: deal-seekers see discounts first, engaged users see premium items, confused visitors see the most reviewed products.

Provides actionable analytics - every decision Drishti makes is logged. Store owners get a dashboard showing what emotions were detected, which CTAs performed best, and how user behavior patterns change over time.

It's for e-commerce store owners who want to increase conversions.
It's a plug-and-play SDK (one <script> tag) instead of building personalization from scratch

html
<script>
  window.DrishtiConfig = {
    apiKey: "your_api_key",
    apiUrl: "https://your-backend.onrender.com/analyze",
    selectors: { headline: "#headline", cta: "#cta" }
  };
</script>
<script src="drishti.js"></script>
Drishti starts analyzing behavior and optimizing content within seconds of integration.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. API Key Tracking Bug — Config Override Priority
The most frustrating bug was that API key usage tracking showed "0 / 1000 requests used" even though the site was clearly making requests. After debugging, we discovered the issue was a config priority chain in the SDK:

DrishtiConfig (set in the component) > SDK Defaults (in drishti.js)
We were setting the real API key in the SDK's default config, but the DrishtiConfig object in the component was overriding it with "demo123" — a demo key that bypasses all tracking. The fix was simple once identified, but it took significant debugging to trace the override chain.

2. DeepFace + TensorFlow on Render
The AI engine uses DeepFace for emotion detection, which depends on TensorFlow. Deploying to Render failed because full TensorFlow is too large for free-tier instances and has no compatible GPU builds. The fix was switching to tensorflow-cpu and replacing opencv-python with opencv-python-headless (servers don't have displays), which eliminated both the size and the libGL.so dependency errors.

3. Real-Time Content Changes Without Breaking UX
Making the SDK update DOM content smoothly was tricky. Naively swapping text caused jarring flashes. We implemented a two-phase transition system — fade out the old content, swap the text, then fade in — with CSS classes (drishti-fade-out, drishti-fade-in). For CTA buttons with SVG icons, we had to carefully preserve the icon while only replacing text nodes, using Node.TEXT_NODE filtering to avoid destroying the arrow icon on every update.

4. Making CTAs Actually Functional
Drishti changes CTA text dynamically (e.g., "Shop Collection" becomes "Claim Offer"), but initially these were just visual changes — clicking "Claim Offer" did nothing different from "Shop Collection." We built a CTA-to-action mapping system that intercepts clicks on the dynamic CTA and routes them to real actions: "Buy Now" adds to cart, "Claim Offer" triggers an actual discount modal with a working promo code, and "Explore All" scrolls to the products section.

**How it helps:**

For example, if an area is unattended or a customer needs assistance, the owner can instantly assign the nearest available employee.

**How it helps:**
- Improves workforce productivity and accountability  
- Reduces idle time and ensures better customer service  
- Enables real-time decision-making using live location data  
- Makes coordination easier without constant manual supervision

**How it helps:**

- Helps identify underperforming areas or time periods

**How it helps:**

### Strategic Planning
Utilizes system data for "Future Market Prediction." By analyzing historical trends, the system can anticipate market shifts—such as which products will see increased or decreased demand during specific seasons or conditions.

**How it helps:**

## Overall Impact

- **Saves Time**: Automates repetitive manual tasks  
- **Improves Accuracy**: Reduces human errors in inventory and finance  
- **Enhances Decision-Making**: Provides real-time insights and predictions  
- **Boosts Productivity**: Optimizes employee utilization and workflow

---

**Challenges we ran into**

## Challenges Faced

### 1. Future Market Prediction
- **Data Quality & Availability**: Incomplete or noisy historical data affects accuracy.  
- **Market Volatility**: Sudden economic or trend changes make predictions unreliable.  
- **Feature Selection**: Difficult to identify the right influencing factors.  
- **Overfitting**: Model performs well on training data but fails in real scenarios.  
- **Scalability**: Handling large datasets with low latency is challenging.  
- **Model Updating**: Requires continuous retraining to stay relevant.  

---
### 2. WebSocket Implementation
- **Connection Management**: Handling multiple concurrent WebSocket connections efficiently is complex.  
- **Scalability**: Maintaining thousands of persistent connections can strain server resources.  
- **Disconnection Handling**: Detecting and reconnecting dropped connections reliably is challenging.  
- **Message Throughput**: Ensuring low latency while processing high-frequency location updates.  
- **Load Balancing**: Distributing WebSocket connections across multiple servers requires sticky sessions or shared state.  
- **Security & Authentication**: Securing WebSocket connections (JWT, token validation) to prevent unauthorized access.  
- **State Management**: Keeping track of active users and their latest locations in real time.  
- **Error Handling & Debugging**: Harder to debug compared to traditional HTTP requests.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/divyadrishti-cfe5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/BitwisePushkar/DivDrish) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://coolify.monu14.me/openapi/swagger) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Off--Grid-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://offgrid.devfolio.co)

> AI That Unmasks AI

![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

DivyaDrishti solves the growing real-world crisis of digital misinformation and AI-generated deception. With the rapid rise of deepfakes and synthetic media, people are increasingly exposed to manipulated videos, fake images, and cloned audio that can spread misinformation, damage reputations, enable scams, and even influence public opinion. Most users lack the technical ability to verify whether content is real or fake, making them vulnerable to fraud, social engineering, and psychological manipulation. DivyaDrishti addresses this gap by providing an accessible platform that uses advanced AI and CNN-based models to analyze and verify media authenticity in real time. Beyond detection, it educates users about potential risks and creates a community-driven ecosystem where individuals can share suspicious content and learn from others’ experiences. In doing so, DivyaDrishti not only identifies fake content but actively works to restore trust in digital information and strengthen society’s defense against AI-powered deception.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the biggest challenges was handling heavy AI model inference using a lightweight framework like Flask, which is synchronous (WSGI-based). Running deepfake detection directly caused blocking and slow responses. To solve this, we integrated Celery with Redis, moving heavy processing to background workers and keeping the API responsive.

We also faced issues managing multiple ML pipelines (image, video, audio), which increased complexity and resource usage. We resolved this by designing a modular pipeline architecture with standardized outputs.

Another challenge was deploying large models efficiently. We optimized this using Docker and careful dependency management.

Overall, the key hurdle was transforming a simple setup into a scalable, asynchronous system capable of handling real-world AI workloads.

**Winners**

DivyaDrishti is an intelligent media verification platform designed to detect deepfakes and AI-generated content across images, videos, and audio. It leverages Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) along with advanced AI/ML pipelines to analyze content at multiple levels - identifying manipulation patterns, synthetic artifacts, and inconsistencies to determine whether the media is authentic or fabricated.

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

To help you articulate the impact of your work for the hackathon or your portfolio, here is a breakdown of the specific problems solved by DOOR DOCTOR and your broader healthcare initiatives.

DOOR DOCTOR: Mental Health & Wellness Ecosystem
DOOR DOCTOR addresses the "silent" gaps in traditional mental health care, focusing on the period between therapy sessions where most patients struggle.

The "Support Gap" Problem: Traditional therapy is usually once a week DOOR DOCTOR solves this by providing 24/7 empathetic AI guidance, ensuring users have support exactly when a crisis or mood swing occurs.

Subjective Reporting Bias: Patients often struggle to remember their moods accurately when talking to doctors. Your real-time emotion tracking provides objective data, solving the problem of "recall bias" in clinical assessments.

Non-Adherence to Routines: Many wellness plans fail because users lose motivation. DOOR DOCTOR uses AI-led behavioral compliance to enforce routines, turning passive advice into active habits.

Social Isolation: Mental health struggles can feel lonely. By building a supportive community into the platform, you solve the problem of social withdrawal often associated with wellness journeys.

Other Healthcare Projects (General Impact)
Based on your work with digital health solutions and specialist platforms, here are the problems those projects tackle:

1. Accessibility & Triage
The "Information Overload" Problem: When people feel sick, they often search the web and find terrifying, inaccurate information. Your AI symptom checkers solve this by providing structured, data-driven preliminary insights.

Specialist Gatekeeping: Finding the right doctor can be a nightmare. Your projects streamline specialist access, reducing the time it takes for a patient to go from "symptom" to "consultation."

2. Data & Efficiency
Fragmented Medical Records: By using cloud synchronization (like Firestore), you solve the problem of disconnected patient data, ensuring that a user's health history is consistent across devices and sessions.

Reactive vs. Predictive Care: Most healthcare is "reactive" (treating the illness after it happens). Your focus on predictive AI tools shifts the focus to "preventative" care, identifying risks before they become emergencies.

3. Technical Modernization
Slow Legacy Systems: Many healthcare portals are slow and hard to use. By using the MERN stack and Next.js, you solve the problem of poor user experience (UX), making health management as fast and intuitive as using a social media app.

Summary for Your Hackathon Pitch:
"Our projects, led by DOOR DOCTOR, solve the critical lack of continuous, objective, and accessible care. We bridge the gap between clinical support and daily life using AI-driven behavioral tracking, ensuring that healthcare is no longer just a periodic appointment, but a constant, predictive companion."

**Challenges we ran into**

Building Door Doctor involved bridging the gap between a traditional "appointment" system and a real-time "active monitoring" platform. This shift created some unique technical headaches.

Here are the specific hurdles we faced and the strategies we used to overcome them:

1. The "Race Condition" in Real-Time Scheduling
The Hurdle: Since Door Doctor relies on real-time availability, we ran into a "Race Condition" where two users could potentially book the last available slot for a specific doctor at the exact same millisecond. Using a standard update() call in the database meant the last request simply overwrote the first, leading to overbooking.

The Solution:
We implemented Firestore Transactions. By using runTransaction(), the app now reads the "availability" status first and only completes the booking if the status remains "available" during the write process. If another user grabs it first, the transaction fails and prompts the second user to pick a new time, ensuring data integrity.

2. UI "Jank" with Real-Time Data Streams
The Hurdle: Because Door Doctor uses onSnapshot to listen for real-time updates (like a doctor's arrival status or a symptom update), the React components were re-rendering way too often. This caused the UI to "flicker" or feel "janky," especially on lower-end mobile devices.

The Solution:

Memoization: We used the useMemo and useCallback hooks in React to prevent unnecessary re-renders of complex UI elements like the map or the health dashboard.

Shallow Comparisons: We refined the listener logic to only trigger a state update if the specific data field needed for that screen (e.g., status) actually changed, rather than updating on every single database pulse.

3. Handling Image Uploads for OCR Analysis
The Hurdle: For the part of Door Doctor that analyzes medical reports (similar to the logic in our Fuel-AI project), uploading high-resolution images of prescriptions directly to the server was slow and often timed out on poor network connections.

The Solution:

Client-Side Compression: We integrated a library to compress images in the browser/app before they were sent to the server. This reduced file sizes by 60-70% without losing the clarity needed for the AI to read the text.

Firebase Storage Triggers: Instead of waiting for the server to process the image, we uploaded it to a cloud bucket which then triggered a Cloud Function to handle the OCR analysis asynchronously. This kept the UI responsive while the heavy processing happened in the background.

4. The "Z-Index" Battle in the UI
The Hurdle: On the frontend, we faced a CSS nightmare where the navigation bars and modal pop-ups (for emergency alerts) were overlapping incorrectly. A critical alert would sometimes appear underneath a background element, making it invisible to the user.

The Solution:
We moved away from "magic numbers" for Z-indexes and established a CSS Variable-based Layering System:

CSS
:root {
  --z-index-base: 1;
  --z-index-nav: 100;
  --z-index-modal: 500;
  --z-index-emergency-alert: 999;
}
This ensured that critical health alerts always took priority on the screen, no matter the context.

Key Takeaway for the Hackathon:
"Our biggest lesson was that real-time healthcare requires 100% data accuracy. By moving from simple API calls to atomic transactions and implementing offline-first synchronization, we ensured that Door Doctor remains reliable even in high-pressure or low-connectivity situations."

**The problem it solves**

In India, a dermatology appointment takes 2 to 6 weeks and costs
₹500 to ₹3000. Millions of people ignore suspicious skin spots on
their face because seeing a doctor is slow, expensive, and
intimidating.

MediScan Assist solves this in seconds.

Open the app, point your camera at any facial skin concern — a mole,
a rash, a suspicious spot — and our AI analyses it in real time and
returns a risk level in under 1 second. Green means monitor it.
Amber means get it checked. Red means see a doctor soon.

We built this for real Indian users:
→ Full Hindi language support — every screen, every button,
  every result reads aloud in Hindi
→ Skin tone personalisation — onboarding captures your skin
  tone, eye color, and hair color so the AI is calibrated
  for you
→ Doctor referral booking — high risk result? Book a
  dermatologist in 2 taps
→ WhatsApp result sharing — share your scan report with
  family or your doctor directly on WhatsApp
→ Scan history — every scan is saved locally so you can
  track changes over time
→ Works on any Android phone — no wearable, no special
  hardware needed

The AI model was trained on the ISIC dataset — the gold standard
in dermatology research — using EfficientNet architecture with
Grad-CAM heatmap generation. A glowing heatmap overlays the
camera feed in real time showing exactly what the AI is
analysing.

MediScan Assist is not a replacement for doctors. It is the
first step that helps people decide if they need one.

Skin cancer is the most common cancer in the world. Early
detection saves lives. We built the tool that makes early
detection accessible to every Indian with a smartphone.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. 🤖 AI & MODEL CHALLENGESChallenge 1 — AI Gives Wrong Results
What happens:

App says Low Risk but person actually has a serious skin condition. Or says High Risk but spot is completely harmless.
Why:

No AI model is 100% accurate
ISIC dataset has limitations
Real world skin looks different from training images
How bad is it: 🔴 Very serious — wrong result could cost someone their lifeWhat to say to mentor:

"We added mandatory disclaimers on every result screen. The app never says you are safe — it always says consult a doctor."
Challenge 2 — AI is Biased Against Dark Skin
What happens:

Model accuracy drops significantly for skin tones 4, 5, 6 on the Fitzpatrick scale. Most Indian users fall in this range.
Why:

ISIC dataset is 80% lighter skin tone images
Model never properly learned darker skin patterns
Lesions look different on darker skin

> Authenticity in Every Frame, Trust in Every Hire.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kaggle](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kaggle-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

The increasing adoption of online interviews in digital recruitment has introduced significant security challenges. Advanced deepfake technologies enable the real-time manipulation of video and audio, allowing individuals to impersonate candidates with high realism.

Current interview platforms lack robust mechanisms for real-time detection and continuous verification of candidate authenticity. As a result, these systems are vulnerable to identity fraud, impersonation, and unauthorized participation.

This limitation compromises the integrity of the hiring process, leading to unreliable candidate evaluation, potential security risks, and reduced trust in remote recruitment systems.

**Challenges we ran into**

Specific hurdle: Deepfake detection models typically require large datasets and long training times, making it difficult to achieve high accuracy within limited hackathon time.

Solution: We propose a real-time deepfake detection system that analyzes video input to identify manipulated content. The system captures live video, extracts frames, and detects faces. These faces are processed using a trained deep learning model (EfficentNet,Inceptionresnet) to identify inconsistencies like unnatural facial movements, blinking patterns, and texture irregularities and also gives confidence score.

The model classifies the video as real or fake in real time. For higher accuracy, audio analysis and lip-sync verification can also be integrated. The system can be deployed in online interview platforms to prevent identity fraud and ensure authenticity.

[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/roziroti-14f5) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/MERAJ-droid/RoziRoti) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://rozi-roti.vercel.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dj9iI6mo4Qg) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Code%20for%20Change%202.0-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://code-for-change-2026.devfolio.co)

> From Work to Worth, Instantly

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Kotlin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kotlin-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

India has **450 million skilled blue collar workers**. Finding one at **9 PM** in Durgapur is nearly impossible. When your motor dies at night your options are call 14 JustDial numbers and hope someone picks up, open Urban Company and find out your city is not served, or wait till morning.
**RoziRoti fixes this.** Workers toggle online when available. Customers search by trade and location and see who is available right now, how far, and how trusted they are. Trust scores are built from actual job completion signals not fake star ratings. One tap, direct call, no middleman.
When internet fails our https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dj9iI6mo4Qg layer kicks in. The worker's phone broadcasts a BLE beacon every second. Any customer's phone within 50 metres picks it up passively with no connection and no server required. Worker appears on screen. Discovery happens phone to phone over the air.
Workers keep 98% of every job. Urban Company takes 20%. JustDial charges for leads. We take 2% platform fee, nothing else.

**Challenges we ran into**

- The first major challenge was BLE GATT connections silently failing on Android 12. We built a full TTL based mesh relay where every phone would receive a worker beacon, connect via GATT, read the packet, and re-broadcast with TTL decremented. On Android 12 these connections failed silently 70% of the time with no error thrown. We switched to advertisement only discovery where workers pack all essential data into 27 bytes of manufacturer specific data in the BLE advertisement itself. No connection needed. Reliability went from 30% to 100%.
- The second challenge was PostGIS returning completely wrong distances. ST_MakePoint takes longitude then latitude but we passed latitude then longitude. Workers 2km away appeared as 140km away. One argument swap fixed it but finding it took hours because the error was completely silent.
- The third challenge was worker location never updating. The API was doing a plain INSERT every time creating duplicate rows and always showing the first ever recorded location. Fixed with upsert using onConflict worker_id plus a PostgreSQL function that updates the PostGIS geography column used by search with live coordinates every time the worker moves.
- The fourth challenge was the 27 byte BLE advertisement limit. A phone number alone is 10 bytes. We solved it by using the beacon only for discovery and fetching the phone number from the server when the customer taps Call. If internet is unavailable the request queues in IndexedDB and executes when connectivity returns.

Team **Git Goblins** -- [Pratyush Pandey](https://github.com/pratyush1120), [Meraj Hussain](https://github.com/MERAJ-droid)

> Secure Land, Immutable Trust

![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

LandChain solves critical issues in real estate transactions by eliminating fraud, ensuring transparency, and accelerating property transfers. Traditional land registration relies on paper trails and centralized authorities, making records vulnerable to tampering, disputes, and delays. LandChain leverages Algorand blockchain to create an immutable, tamper-proof record of land ownership and transactions. KYC verification ensures only legitimate owners can transfer property, while smart contracts automate and secure the entire process. This reduces reliance on intermediaries, lowers costs, and provides instant verification—making land ownership secure, transparent, and accessible for everyone in developing economies where property fraud is prevalent.

**Challenges we ran into**

Building LandChain presented several technical challenges. Algorand's minimum balance requirements complicated wallet setup for demo purposes. Integrating TypeScript with Algorand's SDK required careful type management. Connecting frontend to smart contracts demanded precise ABI handling and state management. IPFS file storage needed proper gateway configuration. MongoDB connection strings with TLS posed connectivity issues. Time constraints made it difficult to implement all features, so we prioritized core functionality—land registration with KYC verification—over complete auction and bidding systems. Balancing security with demo accessibility required creative solutions.

### txn.Verify
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/txnverify-c478) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/gauravnetes/txn-fraud-detection) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hack%20Storm%202.26-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hack-storm.devfolio.co)

> Transactions must be fraud-free

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Managing financial transactions often involves a trade-off between user convenience and rigorous security. Many existing systems fail to detect complex fraud patterns, such as "fraud rings," until after the money has left the account.

This project bridges that gap by:

Preventing Fraudulent Loops: It uses a 3-layer backend logic to identify and block transactions involving known fraud rings before they are processed.

Enforcing Data Integrity: By implementing strict ID validation (matching Kaggle-standard financial formats), it ensures that only well-formed data enters the ecosystem, reducing database errors.

Safe Sandbox Testing: It provides a simulated environment where users can test payment flows using the Razorpay SDK without risking real capital, making it an ideal tool for developers and fintech researchers.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the primary hurdles was integrating the Razorpay Checkout SDK within a strictly validated React environment.

The Bug: Initially, the payment modal would trigger regardless of whether the backend marked the transaction as "ALLOW" or "BLOCK." This created a security loophole where a "fraudulent" sender could still see the payment UI.

The Fix: I refactored the logic to embed the SDK script directly into the global index.html and wrapped the trigger function in a conditional check. Now, the modal is "magically" injected only after the 3-layer backend returns a success state.

Data Formatting: Ensuring users typed IDs in the exact C + 10 digits format was prone to human error. I overcame this by injecting a real-time Regex validator directly into the SimulatePayment.tsx component, providing instant red-line feedback to the user before they even hit "Process."

**The problem it solves**

🚨 Problem Statement

In today’s digital world, misinformation spreads faster than truth. With the rise of social media, users are constantly exposed to fake news, manipulated content, and misleading headlines.

Most people:

Don’t have time to verify every piece of news
Lack access to reliable fact-checking tools
Get influenced by emotionally biased or false information

This leads to:

Public misinformation
Poor decision-making
Social panic and confusion
💡 What Cognify Solves

Cognify tackles the problem of fake news detection and content authenticity verification.

It provides:

🔍 Real-time analysis of news/articles
🤖 AI-based classification (Fake vs Real)
🧠 Credibility scoring for content
⚡ Instant feedback to users before they trust or share information
🎯 Core Solution

Cognify acts as an intelligent assistant that:

Analyzes textual content using AI/ML models
Detects patterns commonly found in fake news
Helps users make informed decisions instantly
🌍 Impact

With Cognify:

Users become more aware and responsible consumers of information
Spread of misinformation is reduced
Digital platforms become more trustworthy

**Challenges we ran into**

⚙️ Challenges I Ran Into

Building Cognify came with several technical and practical challenges:

🧠 Lack of labeled data
Finding high-quality datasets for fake vs real news was difficult. Many datasets were either outdated, biased, or insufficient for accurate training.
🤖 Model accuracy vs simplicity
Balancing between a model that is both accurate and fast was challenging. More complex models improved accuracy but slowed down real-time performance.
⚡ Real-time prediction integration
Integrating the ML model with the frontend to give instant results required careful handling of APIs and response time optimization.
🧩 UI/UX design issues
Designing a clean, premium-looking interface (as per hackathon expectations) while keeping it simple and user-friendly took multiple iterations.
🔄 Handling ambiguous content
Some news articles are partially true or opinion-based, making it difficult for the model to classify them strictly as fake or real.
🛠️ Deployment & environment setup
Setting up dependencies, running models locally, and ensuring everything works smoothly across systems was a bit tricky.

name: LensAssist Project
description: LensAssist - React Native (Expo SDK 54) + FastAPI hackathon app with Claude Vision API. Team InnovAIT.
type: project

LensAssist is a hackathon project (Team InnovAIT) with 26+ scanning use cases for physical-world objects.


## Stack
- Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+), SQLite (dev), SQLAlchemy, Pydantic v2
- AI: Claude API via `anthropic` Python SDK, model `claude-sonnet-4-5`
- Mobile: React Native (Expo SDK 54), Expo Router v6, Zustand, `@expo/vector-icons` (Ionicons)
- Auth: JWT tokens, python-jose, bcrypt

## Structure
- `backend/app/routers/scan.py` — main scan endpoints including SSE streaming summary
- `backend/app/services/ai_engine.py` — Claude vision, streaming, family analysis, scan memory
- `mobile/app/(tabs)/` — dashboard, scan, tools, history, profile
- `mobile/app/scan/result.tsx` — streaming AI summary, family tabs, SOS button, voice TTS
- `mobile/app/onboarding.tsx` — 3-slide first-time onboarding
- `mobile/store/theme.ts` — dark/light/system theme store
- `mobile/store/language.ts` — 9-language i18n store
- `mobile/constants/themes.ts` — LightColors / DarkColors
- `mobile/hooks/useColors.ts` — theme-aware color hook
- `mobile/services/stream.ts` — SSE streaming + family scan API

## Color Palette (White/Green Professional)
- Primary BG: #F0FDF4 (light green tint)
- Accent: #16A34A (forest green)
- Surface: #FFFFFF
- Text: #0F172A
- Camera stays dark: #0A1628 bg, #00C9A7 accent

## Key Features Implemented
- 26 scan modes with Ionicons (no emojis)
- Scan Memory Graph: last 15 scans injected into Claude prompt for cross-reference
- Streaming SSE endpoint: `/scan/{id}/stream-summary` streams Claude narrative
- Family Members: add family profiles, multi-member safety analysis
- Emergency SOS: one-tap SMS on anaphylactic/critical alerts
- Dark mode: system/light/dark toggle in profile, theme-aware colors via `useColors()` hook
- Voice auto-read: expo-speech auto-reads AI summary after streaming
- Animated camera: Animated.Value pulsing corner brackets during scan
- 9 Indian languages: en, hi, mr, bn, ta, te, gu, kn, pa
- Onboarding: 3-slide first-time flow, gated by AsyncStorage flag
- Family tabs on result screen: per-member safe/caution/danger assessment

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![OpenAi](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenAi-333333?style=flat-square) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB%20Atlas-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Traditional learning systems fail to adapt to individual learners, treating everyone the same regardless of their strengths, weaknesses, or pace. Students often struggle to identify where they are going wrong, leading to frustration, low confidence, and inefficient learning.

Existing platforms focus more on content delivery rather than understanding the learner’s thinking process. As a result, users receive generic feedback instead of actionable insights, making it harder to improve effectively.

BrainLoop solves this by acting as an intelligent diagnostic system that analyzes user responses, identifies knowledge gaps, and provides personalized feedback. It helps learners understand not just what is wrong, but why it is wrong, enabling deeper learning and long-term retention.

By making feedback adaptive, targeted, and data-driven, BrainLoop transforms passive learning into an active, self-improving process.

**Challenges we ran into**

One of the major challenges I faced was integrating AI-driven feedback in a way that felt meaningful and not generic. Initially, the responses were too broad and lacked actionable insights, which defeated the purpose of adaptive learning. I had to experiment with prompt structuring, context handling, and response formatting to make the feedback more precise and useful.

Another challenge was managing state and data flow between the frontend and backend while ensuring a smooth user experience. Handling user responses, analyzing them in real-time, and updating the interface without lag required careful structuring of API calls and component logic.

I also encountered issues with UI consistency and responsiveness, especially while designing an intuitive interface that clearly presents feedback and insights. This was resolved through iterative design improvements using Tailwind CSS and testing different layouts.

Overall, these challenges helped me improve my debugging skills, understand system design better, and build a more refined and user-focused product.

**Grand Cash Prize Pool – ₹50,000**

BrainLoop fits perfectly into the Grand Cash Prize track by addressing a real-world problem in education using AI-powered personalization. Traditional learning systems follow a one-size-fits-all approach, which often fails to identify individual knowledge gaps.

BrainLoop acts as an adaptive feedback engine that diagnoses a learner’s weak areas, analyzes patterns in their responses, and provides targeted recommendations to improve understanding. By integrating intelligent analysis with a clean and interactive interface, it enhances learning efficiency and retention.

The project demonstrates strong innovation by combining AI-driven insights with practical usability, making it scalable for students, educators, and self-learners. Its real-world impact, technical implementation, and user-centric design align well with the objectives of the Grand Cash Prize track.

Challenges ClauseBreaker AI Solves
                                                                                 
  ---
  1. The Understanding Gap 📚
                                                                                   Problem
                                                                                 
  - Legal documents are written in complex "legalese" that 99% of people cannot
  understand
  - Terms like "indemnification," "force majeure," "arbitration clause" confuse  
  average users
  - People sign documents without knowing what they're agreeing to

  How We Solve It

  - Plain English Translation - Every clause is converted into simple, everyday  
  language
  - ELI15 Explanations - "Explain Like I'm 15" breakdowns for complex concepts   
  - No jargon, no confusion - Just clear, understandable text

  ---
  2. The Cost Barrier 💰

  Problem

  - Lawyers charge $200-500/hour for contract review
  - Legal aid is limited and overbooked
  - Most people can't afford professional review for every document
  - Result: People sign blindly to save money

  How We Solve It

  - Free to use - Anyone with internet access can analyze documents
  - Instant analysis - No hourly billing, no consultations needed
  - Scalable - One AI can serve millions simultaneously

  ---

  - Most people don't have that time (or patience)
  - Lawyers take days to review and respond
  - Result: People skim or skip entirely

  How We Solve It

  - 30-second analysis - Upload, wait half a minute, get full breakdown
  - Visual risk badges - Red/Amber/Green flags let you spot issues instantly     
  - Searchable chat - Ask "What about non-competes?" and get instant answers     

  ---
  4. Hidden Clauses & Gotchas ⚠️

  Problem

  - Unfair clauses are buried deep in documents
  - Auto-renewals, liability waivers, and rights transfers are hard to spot      
  - Companies bank on you not reading page 17, paragraph 4
  - Result: People get trapped by clauses they never saw

  How We Solve It

  - Automatic risk detection - AI flags every risky clause regardless of where   
  it's hidden

  - Actionable advice - Tells you exactly what to negotiate or avoid

  ---
  5. Version Confusion 📄

  Problem

  - Contracts get revised multiple times
  - Changes are subtle and easy to miss
  - "Track changes" isn't always available
  - Result: People sign revised versions without seeing what changed

  How We Solve It

  - Document comparison - Upload both versions, see exact differences
  - Impact analysis - Understand how each change affects you
  - Side-by-side view - Visual comparison makes changes obvious

  ---
  6. Language Barriers 🌍

  Problem

  - Non-native speakers struggle with English legal documents
  - Immigrants, international students, and foreign workers are especially       
  vulnerable
  - Translated documents may lose legal meaning
  - Result: Misunderstanding leads to exploitation

  How We Solve It

  - Multi-language support - Analyze documents in Spanish, Hindi, French, and    
  more
  - Explanations in your language - Get breakdowns in a language you understand  
  - No lost meaning - AI preserves legal accuracy across languages

  ---
  7. Power Imbalance ⚖️

  Problem

  - Corporations have teams of lawyers drafting contracts
  - Individuals have... themselves and a pen
  - One side understands every word; the other understands almost none
  - Result: Unfair terms favor the powerful

  How We Solve It

  - Levels the playing field - Gives individuals AI-powered legal insight        
  - Negotiation confidence - Know what's unfair, push back with knowledge        
  - No more "take it or leave it" - Informed users can negotiate better terms

  8. Document Overload 📦

  Problem

  - Average person encounters 100+ legal documents per year
  - Terms of service, privacy policies, leases, loans, insurance, medical forms

  - Result: "I Agree" becomes a reflex, not a choice

  9. Lack of Record-Keeping 🗂️

  10. Access to Justice 🏛️

  Problem

  - Legal system is inaccessible to most people
  - Rural areas have few lawyers
  - Marginalized communities are di

> Geo-Fenced Indoor Navigation Engine

![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![WebSockets](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSockets-333333?style=flat-square) ![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-333333?style=flat-square) ![Express.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![React Native](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Native-333333?style=flat-square) ![Twilio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twilio-333333?style=flat-square) ![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind%20CSS-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

There is no **centralised system** where users can easily access reliable information about ongoing public projects or infrastructure changes.

People often don’t know:
1. What project is happening
2. Start and end dates
3. Budget and impact
4. Current progress or updates
5. Related news or announcements

As a result:
1. Citizens remain uninformed and disconnected
2. Misinformation spreads through word-of-mouth
3. There is no easy way to give feedback or raise concerns

Also in large public environments like hospitals, campuses, and urban infrastructure zones, users faces problems like:
**Navigation Confusion**

1. Indoor spaces are often complex and poorly mapped. 
2. Users struggle to: Find departments, rooms, or facilities
3. Navigate across multiple floors and buildings
4. Adjust to blocked paths, construction zones, or temporary changes
These leads to time loss, frustration, and in critical cases, delayed access to essential services.

**Challenges we ran into**

**Using Miro as an Admin Backend**
One of the key challenges was using Miro not just as a design tool, but as a functional admin interface. We needed a way for admins to upload blueprints, generate layouts, and then edit them visually while ensuring the data remained usable for navigation.

How we solved it:
We mapped:
1. Shapes → rooms/locations
2. Connectors → pathways

This allowed Miro to act as a visual flowchart editor, where any changes made by the admin directly reflect in the system’s navigation logic.

**Lack of Reliable and Centralized Data**
There is no consistent or structured source for indoor layouts or public project information such as timelines, budgets, or progress updates.

How we solved it:
We designed the system to be data-independent, where administrators can create and manage their own data directly. This ensures flexibility and removes dependency on external or government datasets.

**Integrating Indoor Navigation Without GPS**
Indoor environments do not support traditional GPS-based navigation, making it difficult to track user position and generate accurate routes.

How we solved it:
We implemented a graph-based navigation system, where users select their starting point and destination, and routes are generated based on the structured layout from Miro.

### EchoDesk
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/echodesk-937a) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Debangshu1129/EchoDesk) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://echo-desk-rosy.vercel.app/auth.html) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/AWJJgV9uYLo) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-Hacktropica%202k26-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://hacktropica2k26.devfolio.co)

> Because every customer deserves an answer.

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Small businesses in India — local restaurants, clinics, salons, coaching centres, travel agents — get the same repetitive phone calls every single day:

"What are your timings?"
"Do you have home delivery?"
"How much is a haircut?"
"Is the doctor available on Sunday?"

EchoDesk solves this by letting any small business create a free, AI-powered voice receptionist in under 60 seconds — no coding, no infrastructure needed. Customers can search for the business by name or phone number and instantly talk to the AI agent, which answers questions from a custom FAQ database. If the AI can't answer, it automatically forwards the query to the shopkeeper's dashboard for a manual reply — ensuring no customer question goes unanswered.

**Challenges we ran into**

Gemini API Rate Limits Mid-Demo
During testing, the Gemini API kept hitting rate limits, which broke the agent mid-conversation. To handle this without a backend, I built a simple key rotation system in config.js — storing up to 3 API keys and letting me switch the active one by changing a single variable (ACTIVE_KEY). Not perfect, but it kept the demo stable.

FAQ Matching Was Too Strict (or Too Loose)
Getting the FAQ matching threshold right was tricky. At first, even closely related questions wouldn't match. After experimenting, a word-overlap score of ≥40% turned out to be the sweet spot — matching enough to be useful without returning false positives.

**Best Use of Gemini API**

EchoDesk uses Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite as the brain of an AI voice receptionist. When a customer speaks to a business's agent, their voice input (converted via Web Speech API) is sent to Gemini, which generates a natural, context-aware response — spoken back aloud via the browser's Speech Synthesis API. This creates a fully conversational, voice-first AI experience powered entirely by Gemini.

Smart API Usage — Not Just a Wrapper
EchoDesk doesn't blindly send every query to Gemini. It first runs a local FAQ matching algorithm (word-overlap scoring ≥40%) and only calls the Gemini API when no FAQ match is found. This shows thoughtful, efficient API usage — reducing unnecessary calls and latency.

Real-World Impact
The Gemini API is doing what no simple chatbot can — holding a voice conversation on behalf of a real business, grounded in that business's specific FAQ data, serving customers who might otherwise get no response at all.
